title: Gingerbread House Decorating
seo_title: Gingerbread House Decorating in Springfield, MO
description: This is a 90-minute gingerbread house decorating session at Pickwick & Cherry's Hampton House, a Victorian home decorated for Christmas with lights and holiday music. A preassembled gingerbread house, candies, decorating supplies, and hot cocoa are provided, so you only need to bring your imagination. It takes place on November 28, 2026 (Time TBD) at 1348 E Cherry St in Springfield, MO.
